subject: Use waveguide plugin from Tidy3D mode solver
message:
Use waveguide plugin from Tidy3D mode solver

Almost all features from the previous solver are available in some form.
We're missing the implementation of the index dictionary that was
overlaid in the previous version to enable the user to set a
non homogeneous index profile over the geometry. That can be enabled
through `CustomMedium` in the future.

There are a few improvements from the previous version, most notably the
use of a non-uniform grid.

This commit solves issues from both
https://github.com/gdsfactory/gdsfactory/issues/1056 and
https://github.com/flexcompute/tidy3d/issues/652.

subject: [fixed bugs] Port.info: shallow copy -> deep copy
message:
[fixed bugs] Port.info: shallow copy -> deep copy

## Problem Statement
In `gdsfactory/port.py` line 315, the `info` was set to `info.model_copy()`. This setting results in a **shallow copy** according to the [pydantic official documentation](https://docs.pydantic.dev/latest/api/base_model/#pydantic.BaseModel.model_copy).

It will trigger a bug that one `info` attribute will still share among different port copies. How I find it: I used `info` to track back the port owner and found `port.copy()` did work except for `info`. And finally I found a deep copy should add argument `deep=True`.
